title.purpose: Project titles; group and value titles step down to 1.25rem and 1.125rem.

lede.purpose: One supporting sentence under a headline, secondary text, 34 to 40ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, spec values, tool names, disciplines.

caption.purpose: Proof captions, table headers, count chips; tabular numerals in counters.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Every screen at rest, primary button hover, gallery arrow buttons.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Front screen of a stack, hovered proof sheet, toast.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every movement: button lift, dot fill, proof fan, reveals, nav sheet, toast.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background state changes.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.value: transform 0.35s ease-out; translateY(-2px) hover, scale(0.97) press

motion.name: proof-fan
motion.purpose: Proof sheets fanning on hover and focus.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: translateY(48px) scale(0.97) to none over 1.2s ease-out

focus.value: outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent); border-radius: 6px
focus.note: Ink ring carries the 3:1 contrast in both themes (#F2F2EE ring on the contact panel and fullscreen viewer); the lime halo is the signal. Replaces the earlier lime-only outline, which measured about 1.6:1 on light grounds.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink button with the lime live dot; the one primary action per view.
components.html: See the work
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; height: 52px; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Satoshi', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #B5D334); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #111111); color: var(--on-ink, #F7F7F5); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(17,17,17,0.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(17,17,17,0.06); } .ds-btn-dot { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--accent, #B5D334); position: relative; } .ds-btn-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #B5D334); transform: scale(0); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-btn-dot::after, .ds-btn:focus-visible .ds-btn-dot::after { transform: scale(1); } .ds-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-icon { transform: translateY(3px); }

components.name: Proof Frame
components.description: Signature: screens stacked on a radial ground; hover lifts the front sheet and fans the two behind it.
components.css: .ds-proof { position: relative; display: block; width: 420px; max-width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 11; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--ground, radial-gradient(120% 90% at 30% 20%, #FFFFFF 0%, #EDEDEA 70%)); border: 1px solid var(--s2, #E4E4E0); cursor: zoom-in; isolation: isolate; padding: 0; } .ds-proof:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #B5D334); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-sheet { position: absolute; left: 9%; top: 13%; width: 82%; aspect-ratio: 1920 / 1120; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #CFE3EA, #8FB6C6); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(17,17,17,0.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(17,17,17,0.06); transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.6s ease; } .ds-s1 { z-index: 3; } .ds-s2 { z-index: 2; transform: translate(3%, -5%) scale(0.94); opacity: 0.85; } .ds-s3 { z-index: 1; transform: translate(6%, -10%) scale(0.88); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-proof:hover .ds-s1, .ds-proof:focus-visible .ds-s1 { transform: translate(-3%, 4%) rotate(-1.2deg); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -22px rgba(17,17,17,0.34), 0 4px 10px rgba(17,17,17,0.08); } .ds-proof:hover .ds-s2, .ds-proof:focus-visible .ds-s2 { transform: translate(6%, -9%) rotate(1.5deg) scale(0.95); opacity: 1; } .ds-proof:hover .ds-s3, .ds-proof:focus-visible .ds-s3 { transform: translate(14%, -17%) rotate(3.5deg) scale(0.9); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Hairline Table

components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Satoshi', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9688rem; color: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--s5, #5E5E59); padding: 0 0 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--s3, #CFCFCA); } .ds-table td { padding: 0.8rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--s2, #E4E4E0); } .ds-table td:first-child { width: 48%; padding-right: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-table td:last-child { color: var(--s5, #5E5E59); } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-table tbody tr { transition: background-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--s1, #EFEFEC) 12%, var(--s1, #EFEFEC) 88%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
A monochrome product-marketing world in which every statement is followed by the screen that proves it. The chrome is quiet: one warm-neutral scale from near-white to near-black, set in Satoshi, sentence case, tightly tracked. The work itself (real e-learning screens, adverts, illustration) carries all the colour on the page; the site contributes only ink, paper, hairlines and a single lime signal.

Density is calm and generous. A 5/7 column split (claim left, proof right) repeats from the hero down through the work pairs, section heads, About and Contact, so the page reads as one steady argument. Proof sits directly on the page, unframed, as screens with one soft shadow, and it moves: frames rise into place as they enter, and hovering a proof fans its next two screens out from behind the first.

Grouped information is tabular, never card-tiled: disciplines, spec lists, toolkit groups, values and contact channels are all hairline rows. The page closes on an inverse ink panel that holds the contact details.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral scale plus one lime accent; the work supplies every other colour.
Satoshi only, three weights with fixed jobs (700 display, 500 UI and labels, 400 running copy).
Hairline rows for any grouped list.
Screens with 14px corners and a single soft shadow, placed straight on the page ground (no containing box); lift and fan on hover.
Exponential ease-out on every movement; content visible without JS.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime marks state and liveliness: dots, active marks, focus, selection. If lime is covering an area or colouring words, it is wrong. One owner-approved exception: the hero headline's key word ("Understood") carries a lime marker highlight at 60% behind it, and the hero headline is set in title case.

rules.name: The Work Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome is neutral so the course screens are the only saturated thing on the page. Tool marks in the toolkit keep their real brand colours at 22px for recognition; that is the one sanctioned exception.

rules.name: The Weight Has A Job Rule
rules.body: 700 for headings, 500 for anything you click or scan, 400 for anything you read. No other weights.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Everything is sentence case with negative tracking on headings. No uppercase labels, no letterspaced small caps.

rules.name: The One Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: A screen gets the soft shadow; the one in front gets the lift. Text blocks, rows and panels get none.

dos: Do follow every claim with its proof in the 5/7 split, alternating sides down the page.
Do keep lime to dots, active marks, focus and selection.
Do place screens straight on the page with the soft shadow and give the frontmost one the lift; do not wrap work in a bordered box.
Do use hairline rows for any grouped list, including tools, specs and contact channels.
Do use the single exponential ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) for movement, and keep content visible when motion is reduced or JS is absent.
Do use weights 700, 500 and 400 only, for display, UI and reading respectively.
donts: Don't use lime as a fill, a text colour or a background.
Don't tile content into identical icon cards; group it as a hairline table instead.
Don't introduce a second accent colour in the chrome; colour comes from the work.
Don't shadow text panels, rows or buttons at rest.
Don't set UI text in uppercase or add letterspaced labels above headings.
Don't use decorative blobs, arcs, tilted stat badges or marquees; the only overlap and rotation belong to stacked screens.
